Committee members

The association is run by a committee of seven members who are chosen at the yearly meeting in November. The chair, the secretary and the treasurer serve for two years, and the others for one. Any member who has held a plot for a year can stand, and the names of those who do are put up in the hut two weeks before the vote.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
